role: Read-only routability audit; no router fitting and no new model or judge calls.
population: The 419 complete development tasks used by C7/C8, each with five models and three frozen repeats.
c9_policy: C9 is excluded because C9.3 requires complete semantic labels for all 480 tasks and those labels are not yet complete.

bootstrap.unit: task with all models and repeats paired

pass_action: Proceed to a 100-150 task decomposition pilot without expanding the full dataset.
fail_action: Stop before decomposition-scale construction and repair task granularity, model pool, or evaluation stability.
